description: Source code for MemoryProgramCache class managing in-memory storage of compiled shader programs, including hashing, caching, serialization, and cache management functions.

classes.name: HashStream
classes.description: Helper class for building hash strings with operator overloading, used for computing program hashes.

methods.name: MemoryProgramCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache with a BlobCache reference.

methods.name: ComputeHash
methods.description: Generates a SHA1 hash for a program based on shaders, context, and program state.

methods.name: getProgram
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a binary program from cache and load it into the Program object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Checks if a program hash exists in the cache and retrieves the binary data.

methods.name: getAt
methods.description: Retrieves a cached entry at a specific index.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cache entry by program hash.

methods.name: putProgram
methods.description: Serializes and stores a program binary into the cache.

methods.name: updateProgram
methods.description: Recomputes hash and updates cache with current program state.

methods.name: putBinary
methods.description: Stores a binary blob directly into the cache.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the cache and resets warning count.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the cache to a specified maximum size.

methods.name: entryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the cache.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Trims cache entries to a specified limit.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns current cache size in bytes.

methods.name: maxSize
methods.description: Returns maximum cache size in bytes.
